summary: Practise crisis escalation, decision logs and recovery priorities in a five-day course. View the outline and assess fit for your team.
lede: Crisis management training helps teams coordinate response decisions and recovery when information is incomplete. It is for crisis team members, operations leads and continuity professionals who need to assess escalation signals, maintain a shared situation picture and record decision owners, assumptions and follow-up actions. Practical exercises also cover role handoffs, prioritizing critical services and preparing concise leadership briefings.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who take part in crisis assessment, incident coordination or recovery decisions and need a repeatable way to document actions under pressure.
prerequisites: Prior experience in operations, incident response, business continuity, risk or crisis team duties is recommended. You should be familiar with your organization’s basic escalation and reporting arrangements. No coding or programming is required.
